description: Bitcoin transaction timing intelligence. Returns a congestion forecast for the next 1-4h, a recommended UTC send window when fees are projected at/below your target, a fee trajectory (rising/stable/falling) with a calibrated confidence score, next-block minimum fee, confirmation targets for 3/6/144 blocks, and an RBF-viability flag. A synthesis layer above raw fee data — the decision an autonomous payment agent needs before broadcasting. Source: mempool.space. Price: 25 sats per call.

hours_ahead.description: How far ahead to search for the optimal window (1-6h, default 4).

l402_proof.description: L402 payment proof "<macaroon>:<preimage>". Omit on the first call; an unpaid call returns a 25 sat Lightning invoice and the macaroon. Pay the invoice, then repeat the call with this argument set.

target_sat_vb.description: Your fee ceiling in sat/vB. The recommended window targets at-or-below this rate. Omit to get the lowest-projected window.

name: optimal_send_window
